DMR_SKYMAP_GALACTIC_53A_4YR.parquet.description: COBE-DMR 4-year 53 GHz channel A galactic-frame sky map, 6144 quad-cube pixels with tabulated RA/Dec, SIGNAL, N_OBS, SERROR.
DMR_SKYMAP_GALACTIC_53A_4YR.parquet.repixelisation: Binned into HEALPix by the tabulated pixel-centre RA/Dec and averaged. This is a repixelisation, not a reprojection, and it is LOSSY. nside 16 is used: at nside 32 the 6144 pixels leave f_sky = 0.4963 and the induced subcomplex is perforated with aliasing holes, so b1 would measure the repixelisation rather than the sky. At nside 16 f_sky = 1.0000 and DMR's 7 deg beam loses nothing.

haslam-408mhz.parquet.description: Haslam 408 MHz all-sky map, destriped source-subtracted 'dsds' reprocessing (Remazeilles et al. 2015) of the 1965-1978 Jodrell Bank/Effelsberg/Parkes survey. HEALPix nside 512, row-packed 3072x1024 in one TEMPERATURE column.
haslam-408mhz.parquet.healpix_ordering: RING -- DETERMINED EMPIRICALLY (the parquet carries no FITS header): the galactic plane/pole mean-brightness contrast is 3.54 read as RING against 1.99 read as NESTED, and the plane/pole std ratio 13.94 against 4.65.

k-band-hdu-1.parquet.description: WMAP 9-year K band (23 GHz) sky map, HEALPix nside 512. Foreground-dominated.
k-band-hdu-1.parquet.healpix_ordering: NESTED -- DETERMINED EMPIRICALLY: plane/pole contrast 27.61 as NESTED against 5.08 as RING, std ratio 71.82 against 4.30.
